checkpoint.title: Pokemon Mansion B1F: the Elixir and TM14

events.why: B1F arrives with the switch on, which closes its north ((33-35, 20-21), (16, 28-30)): the route presses the statue it needs and walks up to (34, 5), beside the hidden ELIXIR on (35, 5)
back along the north rooms to (23, 5), below the ball (23, 4)

checkpoint: Starts on B1F (34, 29) where 13.02 ends, the switch on (start_gates). Ends below TM14's ball at (23, 5), with the switch as the route to the Elixir left it.

The Mansion's statue switches: one flag for all four floors (pokefirered data/scripts/pokemon_mansion.inc, PokemonMansion_*F scripts.inc), a toggle each press flips and each floor applies on load. The pinned maps (PokemonSimulation 4b886bb) carry it as gates: barriers that open when the switch is on or off, and the statues that press it. A route plans the presses itself (PRESS_SWITCH: face the statue, A, Yes, B through the text) wherever a barrier is in the way, and the step's gates_after says the switch it leaves; a checkpoint that starts from a save says the switch in start_gates.
